en-US.name: Tapper
en-US.summary: Control Tapper IPTV on your Fire TV by voice.
en-US.description: Play a channel by name or number, change channel, pause, resume and stop Tapper IPTV on a linked Fire TV.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Tapper to play ESPN
Alexa, ask Tapper to go to channel 204
Alexa, ask Tapper for the next channel

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Private skill for the owner's own TVs.
